name: M5.BirthSearch.birth_none_iff
statement: ∀ (T lower B : ℕ) (C : ℕ → ℤ), M5.BirthSearch.birth T lower B C = none ↔ ∀ N : ℕ, N ≤ B → lower ≤ N → T ∣ N → C N ≤ 0
queries: Finset min prime membership lower bound
guidance: Unfold birth and candidates. None iff candidatefinset is empty; a candidate requires all range/lower/divisibility/positivecount conditions. Use integer not_lt to express nonpositive. This is a finite-interval statement only, not an all-order nonrealizability claim by itself. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.
